text:
Nora P.: Quick heads-up  EU reseller sent a negative invoice (credit) that our importer consumed as a revenue reversal instead of a deferred credit. File: reseller_credit_20260630.csv. Impact to recognized rev: ~33,750 EUR.
BillingBot: [automated] import_warning: reseller_credit_20260630.csv  negative_amount rows mapped to revenue_reverse event (count: 6).
Maya A.: Materiality check: 33.75k EUR < 50k USD threshold but still needs manual deferral for month-end disclosure.
Dana L.: Agreed. Proposed JE (EUR):
DR Recognized Revenue (4001) 33,750
CR Deferred Revenue (2100) 33,750
Memo: "Manual deferral for reseller credit file mistakenly applied to revenue; file reseller_credit_20260630.csv; reversing entry when corrected import or vendor credit memo posts."
Felix H.: Eng root cause: mapping rule treated any negative gross_amount as immediate revenue reduction; should map reseller credits to rebate_deferral. Hotfix queued; will re-run in dry-run and attach logs.
OpsBot: [automated] ticket_created: FIN-EU-312345 (reseller credit incorrectly applied to recognized revenue 33.75k)
Nora P.: I'll prepare spreadsheet with invoice ids/customer ids and EUR/USD conversions. Maya, Dana  can you review and sign off so we can post the JE tomorrow morning?
Maya A.: Please cc audit and include vendor email confirming intent. Approving conditional on packet: spreadsheet, ticket, ops dry-run logs, and final hotfix evidence.
Dana L.: Approved in principle. Add to month-end exceptions pack and flag for close notes. Post JE as of 2026-06-30 and reverse when corrected import posts.
Felix H.: ETA for reprocess logs: 6 hours. Will attach checksum and transform diff.
Nora P.: Thanks all. Tagging @finance-ops and @eng-billing for visibility :white_check_mark:
